content.content:
1	// Cloudflare Web Analytics — privacy-first, cookieless visitor counts.
2	//
3	// Cloudflare Web Analytics sets no cookies, stores no personal data, and can't
4	// track visitors across sites, so it needs no consent banner (see privacy.html).
5	//
6	// The beacon token is NOT a secret — it ships in the client and is visible to
7	// every visitor — so it lives in a GitHub Actions *variable* (not a secret):
8	//   repo Settings -> Secrets and variables -> Actions -> Variables ->
9	//   CLOUDFLARE_ANALYTICS_TOKEN
10	// The Pages deploy (.github/workflows/pages.yml) injects that value into the
11	// placeholder below at build time, the same way js/build-info.js is stamped.
12	//
13	// TO ENABLE: create a free site in the Cloudflare dashboard (Web Analytics ->
14	// "Add a site"), then add its token as the CLOUDFLARE_ANALYTICS_TOKEN repo variable.
15	// It works on GitHub Pages as-is — no hosting or DNS move to Cloudflare needed.
16	//
17	// Until a real token is injected (variable unset, or running locally), this
18	// loader does nothing: no beacon is requested, so the site keeps its "no
19	// analytics" behaviour and never ships a broken tag.
20	(function () {
21	  var TOKEN = 'REPLACE_WITH_CLOUDFLARE_WEB_ANALYTICS_TOKEN';
22	  // Bail out while the placeholder is still in place (startsWith, ES5-safe).
23	  if (!TOKEN || TOKEN.lastIndexOf('REPLACE_WITH', 0) === 0) return;
24	
25	  var beacon = document.createElement('script');
26	  beacon.defer = true;
27	  beacon.src = 'https://static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js';
28	  beacon.setAttribute('data-cf-beacon', JSON.stringify({ token: TOKEN }));
29	  (document.head || document.documentElement).appendChild(beacon);
30	})();

58-      - name: Stamp build info
59-        run: |
60-          TIME=$(TZ='Asia/Jerusalem' git log -1 --date=format-local:'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M' --format=%cd)
61-          printf 'window.__BUILD__ = { time: "%s" };\n' "$TIME" > js/build-info.js
62-          echo "Stamped build time $TIME (Israel) into js/build-info.js"
63:      - name: Inject Cloudflare Web Analytics token
64-        # The beacon token is public (it ships in the client), so it lives in a
65-        # repo *variable*, not a secret. When set, substitute it into the served
66:        # analytics.js; when unset, the placeholder stays and analytics no-ops.
67-        # sed uses '#' as its delimiter so the line contains no shell pipe.
68-        env:
69:          CLOUDFLARE_ANALYTICS_TOKEN: ${{ vars.CLOUDFLARE_ANALYTICS_TOKEN }}
70-        run: |
71:          if [ -n "$CLOUDFLARE_ANALYTICS_TOKEN" ]; then
72:            sed -i "s#REPLACE_WITH_CLOUDFLARE_WEB_ANALYTICS_TOKEN#${CLOUDFLARE_ANALYTICS_TOKEN}#" js/analytics.js
73:            echo "Injected Cloudflare Web Analytics token from the CLOUDFLARE_ANALYTICS_TOKEN variable."
74-          else
75:            echo "CLOUDFLARE_ANALYTICS_TOKEN variable not set — analytics stays off (placeholder retained)."
76-          fi
77-      - name: Prune non-site files from the Pages artifact
78-        # .claude/skills/* are symlinks into the .claudinite/ pack trees, written by
79-        # a SessionStart hook that never runs in CI — so on the runner they are
80-        # absent or dangling, and upload-pages-artifact tars with --dereference,

===README===
# site/ — claudinite.com

The static marketing site for Claudinite. No build step, no dependencies: the
directory is published as-is by [.github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml](../.github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml)
(GitHub Pages via the actions artifact flow) on every push to `main` that
touches `site/**`.

## Layout

| Path | What it is | Who edits it |
|---|---|---|
| [index.html](index.html) | The one page: evergreen copy + the four mechanism explainers | Rarely — structure and evergreen claims |
| [assets/style.css](assets/style.css) | The whole design system (tokens at the top) | Rarely |
| [assets/main.js](assets/main.js) | Animations + rendering of the promoted-content slots | Rarely |
| [data/promoted.js](data/promoted.js) | **The promoted content: stats, spotlight, pack cards, updates** | **Every promo refresh — edit this, usually nothing else** |

## Updating promoted content (the expected frequent, agentic change)

`data/promoted.js` is the single file a routine promo run edits. Contract:

- **Truthful and verifiable.** Every stat, count, and update must be checkable
  against the vendored canon packs in this repo or against its history. No
  aspirational numbers, no invented dates.
- **`updates`** — newest first, ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` dates, ≤ 140 chars, only
  shipped facts. Keep at most 6 entries; drop the oldest.
- **`spotlight`** — the 3–5 features currently being promoted, ordered; the
  first entry renders full-width (visual priority). Taglines ≤ 90 chars.
- **`packs`** — one card per canon pack. When a pack lands in or leaves the
  canon, mirror it here and refresh `stats`.
- **`canonRef`** — keep in step with the `ref` stamp in
  [../.claudinite-checks.json](../.claudinite-checks.json) (short form).
- Keep the file a plain script (`window.CLAUDINITE = {...}`) — it must run
  from `file://` with no module loader.

Evergreen sections (hero, mechanisms, adopt, FAQ) state how Claudinite works;
change them only when the product's mechanisms actually change.

## Local preview

Open `index.html` directly, or `python3 -m http.server -d site` and browse
`http://localhost:8000`.

## Custom domain

The Pages artifact flow takes its domain from the repository's Pages settings
(no `CNAME` file needed). When claudinite.com is connected there, the
`<link rel="canonical">` in `index.html` is already correct.
===CI===
name: CI
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  conformance:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - name: Claudinite world-scope conformance sweep
        run: node .claudinite/shared/engine/checks/check_the_world.mjs

content.content:
EdFringeNow ← Back

Privacy

Last updated 2 July 2026

The short version: no cookies, no tracking, no personal data — just an anonymous count of how many people visit.

EdFringeNow is a static website. It runs entirely in your browser. There are no accounts, no sign-up, and no server of ours behind it — so there is nothing about you for us to receive, log, or keep.

We don't sell your data, and we don't track you across the web. No ads. No advertising trackers. No cookies set by us. The one thing we do measure is anonymous, aggregate visitor numbers — see Analytics below.

Analytics

To understand roughly how many people use EdFringeNow, we use Cloudflare Web Analytics — a privacy-first tool chosen precisely because it doesn't use cookies, doesn't store personal data, and can't identify you or follow you to other sites. It records anonymous, aggregate signals only: page views, the referring site, and a broad region worked out from your request (your IP address is used to derive that, but is never stored). No cross-site tracking, no advertising profile — which is also why there's no cookie-consent banner to click through.

Your location

If you allow location access, your position is used only in your browser to work out which shows are near you. It is never sent to us or to anyone else. Deny it and the app simply falls back to central Edinburgh — everything still works.

What your browser loads

Like any web page, opening EdFringeNow fetches a few files from other services. Those services see your IP address and browser as part of a normal web request, the same as visiting any website:

  • Map tiles from OpenStreetMap.
  • The map library (unpkg) and typefaces (Google Fonts) from their content delivery networks.
  • The privacy-first analytics beacon (a small script) from Cloudflare.

The show and venue listings are plain files served from this site. They describe the festival, not you.

Links out

“Open in Maps” opens Google Maps, and ticket links open edfringe.com. Once you follow a link, that site's own privacy policy applies — not this one.

Questions

Email support@edfringenow.com.

© 2026 Missing Bulb

Privacy Accessibility Terms Contact
